title: jax.scipy.special.gammaln returns inf for smallest positive subnormal float32 input
author: ALinrunrun

comments.author: jakevdp
comments.body: Thanks – this is working as expected. XLA uses flush-to-zero semantics for subnormal values (see https://docs.jax.dev/en/latest/notebooks/Common_Gotchas_in_JAX.html#miscellaneous-divergences-from-numpy) and `gammaln(0.0)` correctly evaluates to `inf`.
